note:
RVLife 9.5/10
The park is on the Crooked River, but the campground sites are in a wooded area set back from the river.  Coastal park near St. Marys (gateway to Cumberland Island ferry). Campsites in maritime forest of palmettos and live oaks; boat ramp and dock. --Claude
summary: Georgia State Parks still book on gastateparks.reserveamerica.com (park page Reserve links, parkId 530149). Confirmed fees $38-44 (now on all 63 sites, Nov 2026 = June 2027).
